newsitem.title: USA: VLSI set to improve chip-making - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: VLSI set to improve chip-making - WSJ.

text.p: VLSI Technology Inc will today announce a major improvement in its chip-manufacturing process, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Monday.
VLSI plans to start making chips composed of circuitry lines 0.20 micron wide late this year, the Journal said. Now, it makes circuits 0.35 micron wide, the paper said on Monday.
The company's president, Richard Beyer, was quoted as saying the new capability would allow VLSI to put more transistors and components onto each chip, the paper said.
VLSI estimated it would spend about $150 million on the shift this year, the Journal said.
